title: Clear space
slide_intent: Tie the exclusion zone around a venue mark to its lettering so the clearance scales with the mark.
strategic_value: Using the same cap-height unit can keep all six venue marks distinct from neighboring graphics in either lockup.
demonstration: Gridded diagrams show Kelham Island Museum in horizontal and stacked forms. Both use the letter cap height as the surrounding clear-space unit.
practical_value: Measure one cap height around the selected venue master in either orientation.

content_islands.name: Clearance rule
content_islands.spec: Place the heading and rule in the left column and name the letter cap height as the unit.

content_islands.name: Horizontal and stacked measurements
content_islands.spec: Stack two dimensioned diagrams at right using the same venue name. Extend guides on all sides and caption the unit beneath the comparison.
